outcome: Genital response (measured by laser Doppler imaging)
cohort: Three groups of cisgender women: primiparous women with vaginal birth, primiparous women with unlabored cesarean section, and age-matched nulliparous women
finding: While women who had vaginal births had lower physiological genital response compared to those with cesarean sections and nulliparous women, there were no differences in subjective sexual response or self-reported sexual function between the groups.
mod_finding: Women who had vaginal births had significantly lower physiological genital response compared to women who had cesarean sections.
